d:
Jio Platforms made a spectacular stock market debut, with its shares jumping nearly 27% on the first day. But there was another record-breaking number behind the frenzy: ₹2,228 crore.
That's how much investors borrowed through the Margin Trading Facility (MTF) to buy Jio Platforms shares on its very first day of trading. It was the highest first-day margin funding ever recorded for a stock debut in India.
So why are investors borrowing money to buy shares? How does Margin Trading Facility work? And what happens when the stock you bought with borrowed money starts falling?
